For a family, I’d compare the final checkout total after adding 15 kg checked baggage for every passenger, not the headline fare.

Give me your departure date, return date, and number of adults/children, and I can narrow this to three exact bookable options.

Option	Typical cost	What you get	Extra cost justified when…

Realestify - Luxury Realty and Management	Premium/custom	More concierge-style management	High-value apartment or frequent maintenance

	Caretaker/key service, pool, parking, power backup

Important: none has a conventional “warranty”; your protection is the platform's cancellation/refund policy. For the first two, the displayed prices are not necessarily 4-adult final totals, so enter your exact dates and four guests before paying.

Also verify security deposit, cleaning/extra-guest charges, GST, housekeeping frequency, parking, power backup, check-in restrictions and refund timing.
